tr.td:
imm_mode → IMM
alu_b_sel → ALU_B MUX
alu_op → ALU

branch_mode → BRANCH
result_sel → RESULT MUX
reg_write → EX/WB

ifex_load / hold / clear → IF/EX
fetch_fault → IF/EX

target_sel → TARGET MUX
exwb_load / clear → EX/WB

mem_owner → MEM_ADDR MUX
mem_size → ADDR_DEC, RAM, ST/LOAD EXT

ram_read / ram_write → RAM
io80_pop / push, io84_pop / push → IO
